content: VLA simulation pipelines use a simulation layer (MuJoCo/robosuite/LIBERO), a VLA model (pi0 or OpenVLA), and a dataset layer. Standard action space is 7-DOF delta EEF pose plus gripper. Observations include 224x224 RGB camera images and 8-dim proprioception. Control frequency is 20Hz. Two dominant VLA families: flow-based (pi0) and autoregressive discrete-token (OpenVLA). Both available open-weights with LIBERO-specific fine-tuned checkpoints.
